text:
carmen: Heads-up  the paper filters for the big office brewer are gone. Just found the empty box under the sink. Who borrowed the last pack? :coffee:

ash: guilty  I used a whole box for a weekend jam session and forgot to replace it. my bad, will restock today.

leo: no worries, but FYI the fruit bowl has three bruised bananas and a suspicious lime that rolled under the toaster. Could we get a quick fruit-rotation plan?

kitchen-bot: stock alert: brewer filters = 0, paper towels = low, bananas = 3 (2 bruised), lemons = 2. Please update inventory sheet: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

jamie: suggestion  rotate fruit weekly, label the top layer with a date sticker so we know what's older. Also proposal: assign "Snack Patrol" for a 1-week stint (tends to fruit, napkins, filters).

ash: if people volunteer i'll cover filters this week. can we automate a reorder for filters when quantity hits 2?

facilities: we can add an automated order for common consumables. quick config (internal):
```
reorder add --item "brewer_filters" --threshold 2 --qty 2 --deliver-to kitchen
```
I'll schedule this for the trial.

carmen: love the reorder idea. small poll: prefer auto-reorder for consumables (:gear:) or manual volunteer restock (:hand:)? react with :gear: or :hand:.

leo: :gear: automations are life.

jamie: :hand: I like people involvement but automation is fine for basics.

ash: I'll place a quick Amazon Pantry order and drop filters on the landing by 3pm. sorry team.

kitchen-bot: reminder set: weekly fruit check every Monday 9am. automations enabled: low-stock reorder for brewer_filters pending facilities approval.

facilities: approved for trial. we'll monitor receipts and tweak thresholds after two weeks.

carmen: outcome: filters ordered by ash, trial auto-reorder enabled, weekly fruit check added. Also, please don't use the brewer as a plant watering station (yes, I saw it). :seedling::no_entry_sign:
